title: India output PPI by manufacturing group
description: Output PPI, manufactured products and its 23 groups (NIC 2-digit), 2022-23 base, latest month: y/y, 3mma (plain average of the latest three months' y/y) and calendar YTD (average index January to the latest month against the same months a year earlier), all calculated from the Office of the Economic Adviser's indices; also manufactured products excluding coke and refined petroleum (code XPET), at the published weights. Built by the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (in_ppi_oea, data/in/ppi/in_ppi_mfg_groups.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each monthly release (14th) by a scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals.
